description: Missed bug #1288: introduced by PR !1072 ("Merged PR 1072: Stop new tenant realms requiring firstName/lastName"), later fixed by 52c907dd1d "Merged PR 1423: WI 1288: stop Keycloak profile form for Entra sign-ins on new SSO tenants". The reviewer should flag the code the fix changed, at major or worse.

fixSubjects: Merged PR 1423: WI 1288: stop Keycloak profile form for Entra sign-ins on new SSO tenants

knownGap: The bug was in the master realm's first-broker-login flow, which PR !1072 did not change (a missing change, not a defect in the diff). Three runs: the reviewer raised the UPConfig write-back and missing backfill; verify rejected both with valid reasons (client/server versions match; the later fix didn't backfill either). It did put 'log in through Entra as a user with only a display name' in the test plan. Kept to detect regressions in the opposite direction and to re-test when the reviewer gains flow-level context.
